table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	InvoiceCode=S.ServiceInvCode, 
	InvDate=S.Date, 
	StudentCode=S.StudentCode, 
	RegNo=ST.RegNo, 
	StudentName = ST.Name + ' (' + ST.RegNo + ')', 
	InvAmt=S.InvTotal, 
	Fine=S.MiscCharges, 
	Discount=S.FlatDisc, 
	NetReceived=S.MiscCharges - S.FlatDisc, 
	UserName=(SELECT U.UserName FROM Users U WHERE U.UserCode = H.SalesmanCode), 
	ReceiptOn=H.Date, 
	ReceiptAmt=D.Credit - D.Debit
FROM 
	GLHeader H, 
	GLDetail D,
	(SELECT SS.ServiceInvCode, SS.Date, SS.StudentCode, SS.InvTotal, SS.MiscCharges, SS.FlatDisc 
	FROM ServiceHeader SS
	WHERE (SS.MiscCharges > 0 OR SS.FlatDisc > 0) AND SS.OutstandingAmt = 0) S,
	Student ST
WHERE 
	H.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND 
	H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
	D.InvoiceCode = S.ServiceInvCode AND 
	S.StudentCode=ST.StudentCode
ORDER BY 
	InvoiceCode
